user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate census tract dataset covering the State College borough area.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve census tract polygons suitable for identifying every census tract that intersects the supplied State College borough boundary. Treat the result as a candidate until spatial coverage and schema are validated at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify the census tract features that spatially intersect the supplied borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the normalized census tract polygons and the supplied State College borough boundary. Retain one feature per census tract that intersects the borough and preserve the tract identifier attributes. Do not guess field names; ground schema fields and spatial predicate behavior from runtime evidence.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean DEM elevation for each census tract identified as intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal elevation for each feature in the intersecting census tract layer using the supplied GeoTIFF DEM rasters. Preserve the tract identifier in the output table. Use the supplied rasters as provided; runtime QC must verify raster coverage, CRS compatibility, aligned grids, and valid zone geometries before calculation.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census tract candidate must cover the spatial extent of the supplied State College borough boundary.
Census tract and borough geometries used for spatial intersection must be valid and non-empty.
Census tract and borough layers must have compatible CRSs for the spatial join.
The census tract dataset must contain a field that uniquely identifies each tract and that can be preserved in the spatial-join output.
The DEM rasters and intersecting census tract zones must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The supplied DEM rasters must have compatible grid definitions for joint zonal processing.
The DEM inputs must cover the zones of all census tracts selected as intersecting State College borough sufficiently to compute their requested means.
Intersecting census tract zone geometries must be valid and non-empty for zonal statistics.
The zonal-statistics output must retain a field identifying each census tract so the mean elevation is attributable to every selected tract.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Conversion Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Converts supported artifact representations without changing the analytical meaning of the data. CSV-to-points requires explicit coordinate-field names and a source CRS.

skills.name: Format and Spatial Conversion
skills.description: Converts data formats between GeoJSON and GeoPackage, spatializes coordinate tables into vector point layers, and exports tabular data.

constraints.spatial: CSV-to-points requires latitude and longitude fields and assigns a documented source CRS.
other: The service does not fabricate missing records or infer unknown CRS definitions.

input_datasets.description: Input dataset in CSV, GeoJSON, or GeoPackage format.

lat_col.description: Name of latitude column in CSV.

lon_col.description: Name of longitude column in CSV.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system for constructed points.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.

input_datasets.description: GeoPackage vector dataset(s) and optional CSV attribute table.

operation.description: Explicit operation name (dissolve, spatial_join, attribute_join, buffer, aggregate, point_count_by_polygon, point_sum_by_polygon).

sum_field.description: Point-layer numeric field to sum for point_sum_by_polygon.

vector_key.description: Field name in vector dataset for attribute join.

table_key.description: Field name in tabular dataset for attribute join.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
